parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
adapt[ədæpt]v.
To adapt means to change in order to deal with a new situation or addition.
→ When he went to the new town, he had to adapt to all the weather changes.
😎
biological[baiəlɑdʒikəl]adj.
Biological describes the process of life and living things.
→ In science, we learned about the biological process of bacterial growth.
😎
cellular[seljələr]adj.
When something is cellular, it relates to the cells of animals or plants.
→ She used a microscope to see the activity at a cellular level.
😎
dynamic[dainæmik]adj.
When people are dynamic, they are lively and have creative ideas.
→ The new, dynamic employee came up with a good way to juggle his work load.
😎
fantasy[fæntəsi]n.
A fantasy is a pleasant situation that people think about but is unlikely to happen.
→ Becoming an astronaut is a fantasy shared by many children.
😎
heredity[hirədəti]n.
Heredity is the process of passing on features from parents to children.
→ The boy's face is similar to his father's because of heredity.
😎
internal[intə:rnl]adj.
When something is internal, it exists or happens inside a person, object, or place.
→ We removed the outer case to reveal the computer's internal wires.
😎
minimal[miniməl]adj.
When something is minimal, it is very small.
→ My lazy husband does a minimal amount of work around the house.
😎
pioneer[paiəniər]n.
A pioneer is a person who is the first to discover or be involved in something.
→ He was a pioneer of computer programming.
😎
prescribe[priskraib]v.
To prescribe medicine means to tell someone to take it.
→ When I was sick, the doctor prescribed me flu medicine.
😎
respective[rispektiv]adj.
When things are respective, they relate separately to each person just mentioned.
→ The boxers were told to return to their respective corners.
😎
revive[rivaiv]v.
To revive someone or something means to restore health or life to them.
→ She revived the feeling of warmth in her leg by rubbing it softly.
😎
rigid[ridʒid]adj.
When rules or systems are rigid, they are severe because they cannot be changed.
→ Societies often have rigid rules about the way that people are supposed to act.
😎
sequence[si:kwəns]n.
A sequence is a number of events or things that come one after another.
→ The dominos fell in a sequence of one after another.
😎
substitute[sʌbstityu:t]v.
To substitute something or someone means to have them take the place of another.
→ When I ran out of juice, I had to substitute water to drink in the morning.
😎
surgeon[sə:rdʒən]n.
A surgeon is a doctor who is trained to do surgery.
→ The surgeon operated on the old man's heart.
😎
therapy[θerəpi]n.
Therapy is treatment for a particular physical or mental illness or condition.
→ After she broke her legs, she used physical therapy to learn how to walk again.
😎
transfer[trænsfə:r]v.
To transfer something means to move it from one place to another.
→ The family transferred the groceries from the shopping cart to the car.
😎
transition[trænziʃən]n.
A transition is a process where there is a change from one form to another.
→ The weather gets colder during the transition from summer to autumn.
😎
transplant[trænsplænt]n.
A transplant is an operation in which a damaged part of one's body is replaced.
→ The sick child needed a heart transplant to live.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: What thing is a result of heredity?
questions.explanation: Màu mắt (Eye color) là kết quả của di truyền (heredity).

questions.content: What process is biological?
questions.explanation: Tiết nước mắt (Producing tears) là một quá trình sinh học (biological).

questions.content: What is something that is prescribed?
questions.explanation: Thuốc cảm lạnh (A cold medicine) là thứ được bác sĩ kê đơn (prescribed).

questions.content: What might be transplanted?
questions.explanation: Gan (A liver) là một bộ phận có thể được cấy ghép (transplanted).

questions.content: What does a surgeon wear?
questions.explanation: Bác sĩ phẫu thuật (surgeon) đeo găng tay (Gloves) khi làm việc.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: The child received treatment for his mental condition after he became depressed.
questions.explanation: treatment for mental condition tương đương với liệu pháp tâm lý (therapy).

questions.content: The medical students learned which processes were occurring inside living things.
questions.explanation: occurring inside living things (xảy ra trong sinh vật sống) tương đương với quá trình sinh học (biological).

questions.content: Unicorns only exist in a situation people think about but will not happen.
questions.explanation: a situation people think about but will not happen tương đương với điều viển vông, ảo mộng (fantasy).

questions.content: When he begins his rule, people will have to change to the new situation.
questions.explanation: change to the new situation tương đương với thích nghi (adapt).

questions.content: At the relating to cells level, plants and animals are quite similar.
questions.explanation: relating to cells tương đương với cấp độ tế bào (cellular).

questions.content: We thought his rules were too severe because they cannot be changed.
questions.explanation: severe because they cannot be changed tương đương với cứng nhắc (rigid).

questions.content: The lively and creative scientist invented a new formula to help stop aging.
questions.explanation: lively and creative (sống động và sáng tạo) tương đương với năng động (dynamic).

questions.content: The creative inventor was a first person to discover the process of electricity.
questions.explanation: first person to discover tương đương với người tiên phong (pioneer).

questions.content: There is a specific number of events that come in an order in which to use the tools.
questions.explanation: number of events that come in an order tương đương với chuỗi/trình tự (sequence).

questions.content: The brilliant doctor brought back to life the dead patient.
questions.explanation: brought back to life tương đương với làm sống lại, phục hồi (revived).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: The surgeon made a small cut into the patient’s skin.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Bác sĩ phẫu thuật (surgeon) tạo một vết cắt nhỏ.

questions.content: The building materials must be transferred to the new site.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Vật liệu xây dựng cần được chuyển (transferred) đến địa điểm mới.

questions.content: The rigid rules were confusing because they changed all the time.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Rigid rules (luật cứng nhắc) thì không thể thay đổi liên tục.

questions.content: The baby prescribed his mother to get a piece of candy.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Prescribe dùng cho bác sĩ kê đơn thuốc, không dùng để nói em bé đòi kẹo.

questions.content: You can observe water’s transition into ice when the temperature gets cold.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Transition into ice (quá trình chuyển hoá thành đá).

questions.content: Blood flow is a biological process.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Sự lưu thông máu là một quá trình sinh học (biological process).

questions.content: I never want to get a new house, so I substitute the one I have.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Substitute có nghĩa là thay thế, không hợp ngữ cảnh này.

questions.content: The dynamic teacher thought of new and exciting teaching methods.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Giáo viên năng động, sáng tạo (dynamic) nghĩ ra phương pháp mới.

questions.content: Going to sleep at night is a fantasy.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Ngủ vào ban đêm là một việc bình thường, không phải là chuyện viễn tưởng (fantasy).

questions.content: He needed plenty of rest after his liver transplant.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Transplant (ca phẫu thuật cấy ghép).

questions.content: The pieces must be put on the machine in the correct sequence.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Sequence (theo trình tự chính xác).

questions.content: I admired how often he chose to be respective.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Respective nghĩa là "tương ứng", thường bổ nghĩa cho danh từ, không đứng một mình miêu tả tính cách như respectful.

questions.content: My new school is great. I can’t adapt to my classes.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Nếu trường mới tuyệt vời, thì đáng lẽ phải thích nghi (adapt) được, dùng can't adapt là mâu thuẫn.

questions.content: Hot dogs are one of my favorite surgical foods to revive.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Surgical food (thực phẩm phẫu thuật) và revive (cứu sống) không hợp lý khi dùng với xúc xích (hot dogs).

questions.content: The heredity expert can tell us how traits are passed on from a father.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Chuyên gia di truyền học (heredity expert) giải thích về đặc điểm di truyền.

questions.content: Please take the big, cellular pieces to the recycling center.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Cellular (cấp độ tế bào) là những thứ rất nhỏ, không phải đồ vật lớn để mang đi tái chế.

questions.content: The hours of therapy were worth it when I could move my arm again.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Trị liệu vật lý (therapy) giúp hồi phục cử động.

questions.content: He’s always the last to understand a joke. He’s such a pioneer.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Người chậm hiểu trò đùa không thể gọi là người tiên phong (pioneer).

questions.content: The internal roof got covered in snow after the storm.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Internal (bên trong). Mái nhà bên trong không thể bị phủ tuyết, phải là mái nhà bên ngoài (external).

questions.content: I was still hungry because I only ate a minimal amount of food at dinner.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Ăn lượng thức ăn rất ít (minimal) nên vẫn đói.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The First Organ Transplant

In 1954, a man named Richard was dying of kidney disease. He wouldn't survive for long unless he got a new kidney right away. Richard's twin brother, Robert, was willing to donate one of his kidneys to his dying brother. At the time, however, no doctor had ever performed a successful internal organ transplant. The idea of taking an organ out of one person and putting it into another was just a fantasy. But the brothers decided to be brave and found a doctor who could make organ transplants a reality.

Since Richard and Robert were twins, their heredity was identical. They had the exact same biological traits. Even their kidneys were identical on the cellular level. Therefore, Robert's working kidney could be substituted for Richard's bad one. Richard's body could adapt to the new organ if the operation was done correctly.

The twins went to Dr. Murray, who was a pioneer of new surgical methods. His dynamic team of surgeons performed the transplant. Dr. Murray made sure his surgeons followed a rigid sequence of directions so that no mistakes were made. First, they made a minimal cut in Richard's side and removed the bad kidney. Then, they made another small cut in Robert's side, removed his kidney, and transferred it into Richard's body. Finally, they sewed up the respective cuts. The entire operation only took about one hour.

After the surgery, it was clear that both brothers were going to be OK. The operation was confirmed a success. Richard's new kidney worked great! Doctors prescribed medicine for the pain caused by the surgery. Since Richard was still weak, he used physical therapy to revive his strength. At last, Richard's transition into a healthy, happy person was complete.

Dr. Murray became a hero in the medical world. His success gave other doctors confidence to try organ transplants themselves. Now, doctors perform life-saving transplants and surgeries every day.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: Internal organ transplants were a fantasy after 1954.
questions.explanation: Sai. Cấy ghép nội tạng chỉ là một điều viển vông (fantasy) TRƯỚC năm 1954, không phải sau đó.

questions.content: Robert was a pioneer of new surgical procedures.
questions.explanation: Sai. Tiến sĩ Murray mới là người tiên phong (pioneer) về quy trình phẫu thuật mới, không phải Robert.

questions.content: The twins’ kidneys were identical on the cellular level because of their heredity.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Thận của hai anh em giống hệt nhau ở cấp độ tế bào nhờ vào yếu tố di truyền (heredity).

questions.content: The dynamic surgeons followed a rigid sequence of directions to avoid mistakes.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Các bác sĩ phẫu thuật phải tuân theo một trình tự nghiêm ngặt (rigid sequence) để tránh sai sót.

questions.content: Richard’s body adapted to the kidney that was transferred from his brother.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Cơ thể của Richard đã thích nghi được với quả thận được cấy ghép từ anh trai.

questions.content: What was substituted in the passage?
options: Robert’s working kidney was substituted for Richard’s bad one.
Richard’s bad kidney was substituted for Robert’s working one.
Dr. Murray substituted the heart of a patient.
questions.explanation: Quả thận khoẻ mạnh của Robert được dùng để thay thế (substituted) cho quả thận hỏng của Richard.

questions.content: What was true of the twin’s biological traits?
options: They had the exact same biological traits and cellular features.
They had similar but not exact biological traits.
questions.explanation: Họ có những đặc điểm sinh học và đặc điểm tế bào giống hệt nhau.

questions.content: What did the doctors prescribe to revive Richard’s strength?
options: Doctors prescribed physical therapy to revive Richard's strength.
questions.explanation: Các bác sĩ chỉ định liệu pháp vật lý (physical therapy) để phục hồi sức mạnh cho Richard.

questions.content: Where did the surgeons make minimal cuts in the respective bodies of each twin?
options: The surgeons made minimal cuts in the twins’ sides.
The surgeons made minimal cuts in the twins’ backs.
The surgeons made minimal cuts in the twins’ chests.
The surgeons made minimal cuts in the twins’ legs.
questions.explanation: Các bác sĩ phẫu thuật rạch những đường cắt nhỏ ở phần hông (sides) của hai người.

questions.content: What was the result of Richard’s transition after his therapy?
options: Richard was a healthy, happy person.
questions.explanation: Quá trình chuyển biến (transition) đã giúp Richard trở lại là một người khỏe mạnh và hạnh phúc.
